title: AbRank Co-Folded 3D: 34,040 Ab-Ag Complexes
subtitle: 10-Pose AF3, Boltz-2, Chai-1 & Protenix WT Scaffolds for AbRank v2
description:
# AbRank Co-Folded 3D: 34,040 Multi-Method, Multi-Pose WT Antibody–Antigen Complexes

This dataset accompanies [**AbRank v2 (`aurlienplissier/abrank`)**](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/aurlienplissier/abrank) with **34,040 precomputed template-free co-folded wild-type (WT) antibody–antigen and nanobody–antigen complexes** (`851` parental scaffolds × `4` co-folding methods × `10` diffusion poses), together with `34,040` per-pose confidence files and `3,760` standardized `LOACO-Local` PDBs.

---

## Contents (8 Files, `3.1 GB` Total)

All `851` WT scaffolds in `cofolding_manifest.tsv` (`340` experimentally solved RCSB co-crystals + `511` unresolved targets) were folded **template-free (`templates=[]` / templates disabled)** across **4 co-folding models** with **`K = 10` poses** (`2` random seeds × `5` diffusion samples):

| File | Size | Contents & Format |
| :--- | :---: | :--- |
| **`cofolding_manifest.tsv`** | `527 KB` | Master table of all `851` WT parental scaffolds (`priority_tier`, `tracks`, `is_experimental_cocrystal`, `wt_pdb_id`, chain lengths, `VH`/`VL`/`Ag` sequences) |
| **`MANIFEST_structures.tsv`** | `8.9 MB` | `34,040`-row index mapping `(method, scaffold, pose_index)` to archive paths and byte sizes |
| **`MANIFEST_confidence.tsv`** | `9.2 MB` | `34,040`-row index of confidence files (`pose_XX.json` for AF3/Boltz-2/Protenix; `pose_XX.npz` for Chai-1) |
| **`af3_10poses.tgz.bin`** | `680 MB` | **AlphaFold 3** (`8,510` `.cif` poses + `8,510` summary confidence `.json` files; `templates=[]`; *non-commercial academic output terms*) |
| **`boltz2_10poses.tgz.bin`** | `702 MB` | **Boltz-2** (`8,510` `.cif` poses + `8,510` confidence `.json` files; open-weight MIT) |
| **`chai1_10poses.tgz.bin`** | `687 MB` | **Chai-1** (`8,510` `.cif` poses + `8,510` score `.npz` files; open-weight Apache-2.0) |
| **`protenix_10poses.tgz.bin`** | `851 MB` | **Protenix** (`8,510` `.cif` poses + `8,510` summary confidence `.json` files; open-weight Apache-2.0) |
| **`cofolded_standardized_loaco.tgz.bin`** | `145 MB` | **`3,760`** standardized `(H, [L], A)` PDBs for all `94` `LOACO-Local` scaffolds × `4` methods × `10` poses |

> **Note on `.tgz.bin` archives:** Each `.tgz.bin` file is a standard gzip-compressed tar archive (`tar -czf`); the `.bin` suffix keeps the archive intact on Kaggle instead of expanding `71,842` individual files. Extract directly with `tar -xzf <file>.tgz.bin` or Python's `tarfile.open("<file>.tgz.bin", "r:gz")`.

## Quickstart

### 1. Download & Extract into `AI-SysBio/AbRank`
```bash
git clone https://github.com/AI-SysBio/AbRank.git && cd AbRank
pip install -e ".[kaggle]"

# Download selected methods into data/structures/ (matches scripts/cofolding/03_ingest_and_evaluate_cofolded.py):
python scripts/cofolding/00_download_cofolded_from_kaggle.py --methods boltz2 chai1 --include-standardized

# Or download all 4 methods (34,040 poses + 3,760 standardized LOACO PDBs):
python scripts/cofolding/00_download_cofolded_from_kaggle.py --methods all
```

### 2. Stream a Single Pose + Confidence File in Python
```python
import json, tarfile
from pathlib import Path
import kagglehub
import pandas as pd

root = Path(kagglehub.dataset_download("aurlienplissier/abrank-cofolded-3d"))
manifest = pd.read_csv(root / "cofolding_manifest.tsv", sep="\t")
print(f"Scaffolds: {len(manifest)} ({manifest['is_experimental_cocrystal'].sum()} solved co-crystals)")

sid = manifest.iloc[0]["scaffold_id"]
with tarfile.open(root / "boltz2_10poses.tgz.bin", "r:gz") as tf:
    conf = json.loads(tf.extractfile(f"cofolded_confidence/boltz2/{sid}/pose_00.json").read())
    cif_text = tf.extractfile(f"cofolded_structures/boltz2/{sid}/pose_00.cif").read().decode()
print(f"{sid} | ipTM={conf['iptm']:.3f}, pTM={conf['ptm']:.3f}, cif_lines={len(cif_text.splitlines())}")
```

### 3. Shell Extraction
```bash
mkdir -p data/structures
tar -xzf boltz2_10poses.tgz.bin -C data/structures/
tar -xzf cofolded_standardized_loaco.tgz.bin -C data/structures/
```

## Reference Benchmark Summary (`34,040` Template-Free Poses)

### Structural Pose Accuracy (`DockQ` vs. All `340` Native Experimental WT Co-Crystals)

| :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| **AlphaFold 3 (`af3`)** | `0.296` | `0.300` | **`0.340`** (`43.8%` / `38.2%` / `20.6%`) | **`0.415`** (`53.5%`) | `+0.684` |
| **Protenix (`protenix`)** | `0.358` | `0.353` | **`0.380`** (`47.4%` / `43.8%` / `24.7%`) | **`0.456`** (`57.1%`) | `+0.731` |
| **Chai-1 (`chai1`)** | `0.391` | `0.392` | **`0.395`** (`50.3%` / `45.6%` / `27.9%`) | **`0.440`** (`53.2%`) | **`+0.771`** |
| **Boltz-2 (`boltz2`)** | **`0.561`** | **`0.516`** | **`0.550`** (`65.9%` / `63.2%` / `43.2%`) | **`0.598`** (`69.7%`) | `+0.731` |
| **40-Pose Multi-Method Pool** | — | — | **`0.577`** (`68.8%` / `65.9%` / `45.9%`) | **`0.677`** (`77.9%`) | — |

| 3D Model | Native Co-Crystal | Unbound IgFold | `AF3` Top-1 `ipTM` | `Protenix` 10-Pose Ens | `Boltz-2` Top-1 `ipTM` | `Chai-1` Top-1 `ipTM` | `40-Pose Consensus` |

- **AlphaFold 3 Output Terms**: `af3_10poses.tgz.bin` and the `af3/` directory inside `cofolded_standardized_loaco.tgz.bin` contain **AlphaFold 3** predicted outputs governed by Google DeepMind's AlphaFold 3 Output Terms of Use (**non-commercial academic research only**; do not use AlphaFold 3 outputs to train competing structure-prediction models or for commercial purposes). Users requiring strictly open-weight predictions should extract only `boltz2`, `chai1`, and/or `protenix`.
- **Upstream Sequence Provenance**: All 851 scaffold sequences come from the 24 public datasets documented in `aurlienplissier/abrank` (`metadata/sources_manifest.yaml`).

resources.description: Master manifest of all 851 wild-type parental antibody-antigen and nanobody-antigen scaffolds folded across AF3, Boltz-2, Chai-1, and Protenix, including priority tier, experimental co-crystal status, PDB IDs, and standardized 20-AA VH/VL/Ag sequences.

fields.name: scaffold_id
fields.description: Canonical unique wild-type parental scaffold identifier matching directory names inside the co-folded archives.

fields.name: priority_tier
fields.description: Co-folding priority tier: 1_loaco_local (94 primary LOACO-Local scaffolds), 2_candidate_and_vhh (416 candidate & VHH scaffolds), or 3_cross_modal_and_global (341 cross-modal & global scaffolds).

fields.name: tracks
fields.description: Semicolon-delimited list of AbRank evaluation tracks that reference this WT parental scaffold (e.g., loaco_local, candidate, vhh, cross_modal, global).

fields.name: is_experimental_cocrystal
fields.description: Boolean indicating whether an experimentally solved RCSB PDB bound co-crystal exists for this WT complex (340 True, 511 False).

fields.name: wt_pdb_id
fields.description: 4-character experimental RCSB PDB identifier of the native WT complex, or NONE if no experimental co-crystal exists.

fields.name: ref_scaffold_pdb
fields.description: Relative path to the standardized reference WT scaffold PDB (native co-crystal or unbound IgFold + antigen template) in aurlienplissier/abrank.

fields.name: n_chains
fields.description: Number of polypeptide chains folded in the complex (3 for paired VH+VL+Ag; 2 for single-domain VHH+Ag).

fields.name: total_aa_len
fields.description: Total concatenated amino acid sequence length across all folded chains (len_H + len_L + len_A).

fields.name: len_H
fields.description: Amino acid length of the heavy chain variable domain (VH) or single-domain nanobody (VHH).

fields.name: len_L
fields.description: Amino acid length of the light chain variable domain (VL); 0 for single-domain VHH nanobodies.

fields.name: len_A
fields.description: Amino acid length of the assayed antigen ectodomain sequence.

fields.name: seq_H
fields.description: Standardized 20-AA heavy chain variable domain (VH) or nanobody (VHH) sequence used as co-folding input.

fields.name: seq_L
fields.description: Standardized 20-AA light chain variable domain (VL) sequence used as co-folding input (empty for VHH nanobodies).

fields.name: seq_A
fields.description: Standardized 20-AA antigen ectodomain sequence used as co-folding input.

resources.description: Complete 34,040-row inventory indexing every co-folded mmCIF structure (851 WT scaffolds x 4 methods x 10 poses) with archive paths, original solver filenames, and uncompressed byte sizes.

fields.name: method
fields.description: Template-free structure prediction engine: af3 (AlphaFold 3), boltz2 (Boltz-2), chai1 (Chai-1), or protenix (Protenix).

fields.name: scaffold
fields.description: Wild-type parental scaffold identifier (joins directly to scaffold_id in cofolding_manifest.tsv).

fields.name: pose_index
fields.description: Zero-based diffusion pose index (0 through 9 across 2 seeds x 5 samples; Boltz-2 pre-sorts pose 0 by confidence score).

fields.name: bundled_name
fields.description: Relative structure path inside cofolded_structures/ within the method archive (e.g., af3/<scaffold>/pose_00.cif).

fields.name: source_relpath
fields.description: Original solver output relative path prior to uniform pose_XX.cif naming (records exact seed and diffusion sample ID).

fields.name: bytes
fields.description: Uncompressed file size in bytes of the mmCIF structure file.
